# Langton's Ant: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/langtons-ant` `fc52838` (24 October 2026) on 30 October 2026.

## Tests

80 `it` or `test` calls across nine unit files: docs, golden, grid, highway, presets, restore, rule, serialize and simulation. A capture spec adds one more call. `tests/bench.test.ts` is the throughput benchmark and is not in the 80. The older "99 passing" figure was a run result and was not repeated, so 80 is a grep count, not a pass count.

:::
